film_time_note: 30 fps, 1413 frames (47.1 s), REAL TIME 1:1 (no slow motion): frame f shows real time f / 30 s until the cut at frame 713 (23.77 s); from there real time 58.01 + (f / 30 - 23.77) s (34.2 s of drilling and the base's wrap are skipped). cam:A (static wide) up to the cut, cam:B (static, side-on to the line) after it. Keys are sparse: interpolate LINEARLY between keys, never across the cut (frames 712 and 713 are both keys). Around the shot and the impact some keys sit on quarter frames (e.g. 320.25) so motion blur sees the motion between frames: key them at those fractional frames. Tolerances 0.0001 m, 1e-05 quat, 0.02 deg, line 0.001 m.
units: metres, world: Z up, +X launch direction, origin = centre of the board top (z 0)
real_time_of_frame: t = f / fps for f < cut.frame, else cut.real_time_after + (f - cut.frame) / fps
base_to_world_note: world_m = base_to_world @ S(0.001) @ M_base_mm, where M_base_mm is a part's base-frame transform: asm.json 'place' composed with its joint chain, JW(joint) @ place (tools.assembly.world). objects[base:*] give exactly that per frame (set it as matrix_world). Frame 0 is the load state = models.py's rest pose; parts that never move and sit at base_to_world @ place are omitted. Base frame (BASE_SPEC section 2): origin on the wiper / main shaft axis, deck top z -165 mm, deck underside -173 mm: base_to_world puts the deck underside on the board top (z 0) and centres the deck footprint on the origin; no rotation.

line_wraps.note: capstan turns of the tether while the wrap cup has laid them (the main line skips them with a chord inside the drum)

sources.base: base/cad/parts (drum, frame, launch, reel, sensors: joints, kin, line_path) posed with base/out/base/asm.json; real-time motor schedule base_motion.RealSchedule (wiper DC motor 45 rpm / 15 N m against the springs and trains, drum N20 8.1 deg/s, firmware C1 order)
sources.shot: base/physics launcher.py chain-spring trace via kedge/dart_model.launch_trace; carriage stop flexure model
sources.flight: kedge/flight34.py strip aero in 3D (dart_motion.Flight3D), 0.25 N payout drag on the tail tie, cross-wind
sources.landing: kedge/sim_righting simCore + v34_check/run34_shared.mjs SimV34 (rigid axle, tail tie), loam, started from the flight's end state, no blend
sources.line: render/motion/rope.py on the base line_path (reel.line_spans + launch.line_path) and over the muzzle lip roller

dart.auger_note: auger joints: axis = the auger's own axis toward its tip in the pod frame; deg already carries the drill-in sign (right-hand flight turns + about the tip direction): both screw in
dart.sim_to_world: world = C_SIM @ sim (x, y up, z right) -> (X, -z, y), same origin
